brief: The burning-ground grove at night: a slim spirit of pale morning light leaning forward as if about to run, hair streaming ahead; the Vetāla hanging above with a sly look; you, Dādī and Śuka in the foreground; a glow of dawn beginning at the far edge of the trees.
notes: Painting reviewed against its exact source brief. Every visible text string compared with the recorded source text; reference font inspected when needed. This is direct visual review, not an OCR-service result.
